answer: A practical sybil defence binds each identity to work nobody else can outsource: every new agent solves a unique puzzle derived from its own hardware fingerprint and signs the attestation before transacting. A narrow inlet admits one boat at a time, throttling mass account creation without blocking honest newcomers. Sponsors stake reputation on the agents they admit, so a fake island of clones collapses when a voucher is slashed. Light zephyr-like re-attestation clears dormant fakes, and credentials rest in a vault whose keys never leave the attested device.
